output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by Tiled Canvas. Everyone on build 7.4.0 crashes at about 2%, against about 0.7% on 7.3.2. That was already true on 2 Sep, before the flag ramp. Within 7.4.0, flagged users (2.10%) and the random holdout (1.98%) differ by only 0.12 points, and that difference could be chance. Flagged users look the same as the holdout on device memory and usage. The top crash cluster in 7.4.0 (41% of events) is a native crash in the upgraded Pixelda image library, which 7.3.2 doesn't have. No crash stack contains canvas code. The app-store console, which counts crashes separately from our crash-reporting tool, shows the same gap, so it isn't a counting artifact. The 9 Sep backend deploy didn't change 7.3.2's rate. Turning the flag off and releasing 7.4.0 to 100% would ship the real crash source to everyone. Hold 7.4.0 at 25% and fix the Pixelda crashes. Keep the existing holdout running to settle whether the flag adds a small effect. Don't roll back the crash-reporting SDK. I'm fairly confident, and a small flag effect isn't ruled out.
